name: River of Life Food Pantry
eligibility: River of Life Food Pantry welcomes individuals and families experiencing food insecurity. Requirements to Receive Food: A valid form of identification (ID) is required. All households must complete a brief informational registration form. We serve individuals and families from ALL ZIP codes. No proof of income or church attendance is required. All food assistance is provided FREE of charge. Food distribution takes place every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM through our convenient drive-through system. Food is available while supplies last.
notes:
